Jennifer Aniston still earns $20 million yearly from Friends
story.summary: Jennifer Aniston reportedly continues to earn $20 million annually from Friends, more than 20 years after the sitcom ended. The show’s six stars initially earned $22,500 per episode before collective negotiations pushed their salaries to $1 million in the final seasons. A groundbreaking profit-sharing deal also helped the cast benefit from the sitcom’s enduring popularity and continued revenue.
